mode.description: The mode that the Admin API token is authorized for.

key.title: key
key.description: The public token that refers to your API key, as distinct from the API Secret.

expires_at.title: expires_at
expires_at.description: Timestamp used to set when this key automatically expires.

last_used_at.title: last_used_at
last_used_at.description: Date the API key was last used in a Pinwheel API request. Null if the key hasn't been used.

is_active.title: is_active
is_active.description: If true, the API key can be used in Pinwheel API requests. Otherwise, the key is no longer useable.

revoked_at.title: revoked_at
revoked_at.description: Timestamp of when this key was revoked.
